title: Create an OTA (before M5 billing)
caption: createTenant writes six rows in one transaction and dispatches tenant.provision after the commit. With FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING on, it opens a Stripe Checkout instead and the webhook opens the dispatch gate.

steps.label: POST /v1/tenants {key, name, countryCode, defaultCurrency, timeZone} + Idempotency-Key
idempotency lock vx:idem:<acc>:<key>:lock (503 while Redis is down)
lock account FOR UPDATE: verified + active (403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED)
key free and not reserved (409 TENANT_KEY_UNAVAILABLE); < MAX_TENANTS_PER_ACCOUNT non-failed (422 tenant_limit)

INSERT tenants (provisioning, test), tenant_memberships (owner), subscriptions (manual trialing), tenant_domains (<key>.ota.example.com verified primary), provisioning_jobs (provision, queued), platform_audit_log tenant.created
dispatch: job running, attempt 1, locked_until +15 min
steps.note: Dispatch failure never fails the call: the reconciler takes a job left queued.

steps.label: M5 only: customer + Checkout Session (idempotency checkout:<tenantId>:<key>)
steps.note: Then checkoutUrl is returned and the job stays queued until checkout.session.completed.

steps.label: poll GET /v1/tenants/{id}/provisioning until active or failed
